title: refcheck config show --json
description: Every value a run started in one directory resolves, one row per key and layer. A key with several contributing layers, such as scan.exclude, has a row for each. A config file refcheck cannot take as written exits 2 and prints no document.

start.description: The directory the run would start in.

key.description: A config key as table.key, or user_config_file, repo_config_file or rules_file for a file refcheck reads or writes.

value.description: The resolved value. Null where no such file applies, such as a repo with no repo config, and for a built-in exclusion decided by a rule rather than patterns, which its note states.

layer.description: What set the value. default: refcheck's own default. builtin: a built-in exclusion list. environment: an environment variable, which the note names. discovered: found by searching from the start directory. user_config or repo_config: that config file.

note.description: Prose for a reader, never a value to branch on: which variable or search found a file, that it is not there, or which built-in list a row is. Null where there is nothing.
